notes: Boxes are the PDF widgets (1 page). The 'Type of Request' checkboxes have no widgets, so request_type has no box. The three widgets named 'Digital ImagesIndexes 1-3' are the lines under 'Please state your document request below' (misnamed in the PDF); the request is a multi-line answer, so only line 1 carries the path. Pathless: the requester signature and the whole 'For Administrative Use Only' block (Date received, Action taken lines and dates, clerk representative signature/date, Amount Due), which is staff-only.
